SEARCH
Package nl.pim16aap2.lightkeeper.provisioning

Record Class ServerSpecification

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
nl.pim16aap2.lightkeeper.provisioning.ServerSpecification
Record Components:
serverVersion - The version of the server to prepare.
jarCacheDirectoryRoot - The directory where the server JAR files are cached.
baseServerCacheDirectoryRoot - The directory where the base server files are cached.
serverWorkDirectoryRoot - The directory where the server will run and store its data.
runtimeManifestPath - Destination of the generated runtime manifest.
versionedCacheDirectories - Whether to use versioned cache directories for the server JAR and base server.
jarCacheExpiryDays - The number of days after which the cached server JAR files expire and should be rebuilt/redownloaded.
forceRebuildJar - Whether to force the server JAR to be rebuilt/redownloaded, even if it is already cached.
baseServerCacheExpiryDays - The number of days after which the cached base server files expire and should be recreated.
forceRecreateBaseServer - Whether to force the base server to be recreated, even if it is already cached.
cleanupUnusedCacheDirectories - Whether to prune expired sibling cache-key directories in jar/base cache parents during prepare.
serverInitTimeoutSeconds - The number of seconds to wait for the server to initialize before timing out.
serverStopTimeoutSeconds - The number of seconds to wait for the server to stop gracefully before timing out.
serverStartMaxAttempts - Maximum number of attempts to initialize the prepared baseline.
memoryMb - The amount of memory (in MB) allocated to the server.
javaExecutablePath - Java executable selected by the caller for running the server.
extraJvmArgs - Additional JVM arguments to pass when starting the server.
cacheKey - Identity of the resolved server inputs used to separate cached baselines.
paperUserAgent - HTTP User-Agent used for server downloads.
agentJarSha256 - Expected embedded agent checksum, or null for an agent-free base preparation.
agentAuthToken - Runtime handshake token installed into the prepared manifest.
runtimeProtocolVersion - Wire protocol version expected by the runtime agent.
agentCacheIdentity - Embedded agent identity included in preparation provenance.
public record ServerSpecification(String serverVersion, Path jarCacheDirectoryRoot, Path baseServerCacheDirectoryRoot, Path serverWorkDirectoryRoot, Path runtimeManifestPath, boolean versionedCacheDirectories, int jarCacheExpiryDays, boolean forceRebuildJar, int baseServerCacheExpiryDays, boolean forceRecreateBaseServer, boolean cleanupUnusedCacheDirectories, int serverInitTimeoutSeconds, int serverStopTimeoutSeconds, int serverStartMaxAttempts, int memoryMb, String javaExecutablePath, @Nullable String extraJvmArgs, String cacheKey, String paperUserAgent, @Nullable String agentJarSha256, String agentAuthToken, int runtimeProtocolVersion, String agentCacheIdentity) extends Record
Represents the shared specification for preparing a Minecraft server baseline.

The base server is a cached version of the server that can be reused across different builds or runs of the server. The test server is created by copying the base server to a new directory where it can be run independently.

If the base server is not available or needs to be recreated, it will be downloaded and prepared, which will include downloading/compiling the server JAR file, configuring the server, and running it to ensure it is ready for use.
